name: Haldora launch: brand, site, portal, app and product experience
objective: Launch Haldora, a home battery company, with one coherent identity across a marketing website, a customer energy portal, an iOS and Android app and an interactive 3D presentation of the Haldora Cell battery.
background: Haldora sells the Cell, a wall-mounted home battery, and the software that decides when a household stores, uses or sells its solar power. Buyers are homeowners, not engineers. The category looks either like industrial equipment or like a gadget; Haldora wants to look like something that belongs in a home.

audiences.name: Homeowners with rooftop solar
needs: Understand what the battery does across a day
Trust that it is safe and quiet
See savings without reading a manual

audiences.name: Existing customers
needs: Check the battery and today's flows at a glance
contexts: Daily, a few seconds at a time

audiences.name: Arabic-speaking households in the Gulf
needs: Arabic typography that is not an afterthought

competitors.name: Category convention: industrial energy brands
competitors.notes: Dark dashboards, green on black, technical language.

competitors.name: Category convention: consumer gadget brands
competitors.notes: White minimalism, glossy product renders, little explanation.

successMeasures: A first-time visitor can say what the product does after one scroll
A customer can read battery level and change the reserve in under ten seconds
